en: \[Claude Tag] Added a Guests setting to the Add channel and Add workspace forms in Claude Tag admin settings, so owners can pick Inherit, Allow, Channel only or Restrict up front
zh: \[Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 管理设置的 Add channel 和 Add workspace 表单中新增 Guests 设置，所有者可预先选择 Inherit、Allow、Channel only 或 Restrict
